name: MacnBTC
blurb: A trading-focused account active on X since May 2018, with a follower count in the high hundreds of thousands. The byline is 'Mac' and the avatar a wolf; content centres on chart-based trade ideas across both crypto and US equities, including past calls on Bitcoin macro levels, altcoins (SOL, MATIC), and large-cap stocks (TSLA, AAPL).
recent: The bookmarked tweet recommends a basket of AI-infrastructure names — Sivers Semiconductors (SIVE), Lumentum (LITE), Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI), and Micron (MU) — accompanied by screenshots showing strong daily moves and a single line: 'still not too late to buy these btw.' The account historically promotes free trading content rather than paid groups, and its style leans short and chart-driven rather than analytical.
credibility_note: MacnBTC is a personality-led trading account, not a research shop. Calls are short-form and lack the company-level financial analysis or risk caveats one would expect from a sell-side note. The four names selected are real and the underlying AI-optics/memory thesis is mainstream; the question of 'too late' is a judgement call the tweet does not engage with.
